articles.title: NIO Faces Record Recall As Battery Swap Milestone Tests Investment Thesis
articles.mainIdea: NIO Faces Record Recall As Battery Swap Milestone Tests Investment Thesis
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: NIO Faces Record Recall As Battery Swap Milestone Tests Investment Thesis. NIO recalls more than 246,000 vehicles due to a software issue that can disable dashboard and control screens. The company reports that this is its largest recall to date, focused on driver interface software fixes. Separately, NIO completes its 100,000,000th battery swap, marking a major milestone for its battery swapping network. For investors watching NYSE:NIO, the news presents mixed signals.
